mapper.select: select count(*) from app_member where status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from app_member where status = 'ACTIVE' and created_at::date = #{date}
select count(*) from reservation where reservation_date = (#{date}::date - interval '1 day')::date
select count(*) from charger where status = '사용가능'
select count(*) from charger where status = '사용중'
select count(*) from charger where status = '예약중'
select count(*) from charger where status in ('점검중', '고장')
select coalesce(sum(actual_cost), 0)::bigint from charging_session where status = '완료' and actual_end_time::date = #{date}

select r.reservation_id as reservationId , m.member_name as memberName , vm.model_name as modelName , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , r.start_time as startTime , r.end_time as endTime , r.status as status from reservation r join app_member m on r.member_id = m.member_id join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where r.reservation_date = #{date} order by r.start_time asc limit 5

select cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as address , cs.station_status as stationStatus , count(c.charger_id) as totalChargerCount , count(case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 end) as availableChargerCount , count(case when c.status in ('점검중', '고장') then 1 end) as troubleChargerCount from charging_station cs left join charger c on cs.station_id = c.station_id group by cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.station_status order by cs.station_id desc limit 5
